findings.title: Media-query evaluation reimplemented four times with divergent feature support and unit bugs
cerberus-style has zero tests despite owning viewport/length resolution + computed-style defaults
No diagnostics facility in library crates; failures silently swallowed, app-only eprintln!
object-position/background-position two same-axis keywords silently misparses; untested

no_findings_areas: No todo!()/unimplemented!()/FIXME stubs anywhere in the tree
pick_img_url/select_srcset shared cleanly between fetch and layout (no divergent walk)
non-test unwraps in rendering crates are minimal and bounded (min/max on non-empty)
overall_health: Good. High-churn rendering engine with a mature, dense issue backlog already capturing most P0/P1/P2 debt. New findings are convergence/observability/untested-path gaps, not correctness emergencies. No CRITICAL/HIGH from this run.
